blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 思维链(CoT)推理实践证明,通过将复杂的任务分解成分步骤的解决方案,有效地提高了大语言模型的推理能力. 近年来,研究人员试图将CoT推理扩展到视觉遗传模型,以提高他们处理复杂任务的能力. 然而,现有的COT用于文本到图像生成的方法仍然主要依赖于文本推理,因此无法充分利用和保存图像中已经存在的正确的语义信息,因为即使是最详细的语言也无法捕捉所有视觉信息. 随着图像生成的进步,FLUX和BAGEL等模型可以生成以视觉输入为条件的图像. 近期的作品试图将图像作为思维链的上下文来前传,但这带来了另一个限制:不合适的早期图像可以强烈干扰模型,而重复的全图像再生则在每一回合引入新的幻觉,并导致它们积累. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出MLIE-CoT,这是一个基于多层次图像编辑的视觉思维链框架. MLIE-CoT学习从三个层次选择修复颗粒,在推理过程中尽可能保留正确的语义,同时降低错误内容的影响. 为了提高多式联运模型的能力,将不同严重性差错路由到适当的修复水平,我们构建了一个涵盖不同错误情况的图像修复数据集,并利用它来训练一个修理级别的路由器. 广泛的实验表明,MLIE-CoT使用固定修理战略,其基本模型和方法都大大超过其基本模型和方法,在多个基准方面产生了明显的改进。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: High-quality text-to-image models can now generate visually appealing images, yet complex compositional prompts continue to reveal recurring reliability issues: target objects may be missing, colors may be assigned to the wrong objects, counts may differ from the request, and spatial relations may be reversed ( Chefer et al. 2023 ; Ghosh, Hajishirzi, and Schmidt 2023 ; Huang et al. 2023 ; Wan and Chang 2025 ) . Even state-of-the-art diffusion-based models struggle to satisfy every requirement of a complex prompt in a single forward generation, and the difficulty grows as prompts combine more subjects, attributes, counts, and spatial relations ( Huang et al. 2023 ; Wan and Chang 2025 ) . Although most constraints may be met, small local errors often remain. Simply emphasizing a previously missed detail does not guarantee a fix, because a new sample may trade the original error for a different one.
blocks.zh: 高质量的文本到图像模型现在可以生成视觉上具有吸引力的图像,然而复杂的组成提示继续揭示反复出现的可靠性问题:目标对象可能缺失,颜色可能分配给错误对象,计数可能与请求不同,空间关系可能倒置(Chefer等人. 2023; Ghosh, Hajishirzi, and Schmidt 2023; Huang等人 2023; Wan and Chang 2025 ). 即使是最先进的传播模式,在单一的前沿一代中也努力满足复杂即时的每一项要求,随着即时因素将更多的主体,属性,计数,空间关系结合在一起,难度也随之增大(黄 al等人,2023年;万和昌2025年). 虽然大多数限制可能得到满足,但当地的小错误往往依然存在。 仅仅强调以前遗漏的细节并不能保证固定,因为新的样本可能会将原来的错误换成不同的错误。

blocks.en: Extending chain-of-thought reasoning to image generation is therefore a natural direction. Visual CoT Diffusion, ImageGen-CoT, and stepwise verification or reinforcement methods have demonstrated the value of intermediate reasoning for image generation ( Harvey and Wood 2023 ; Liao et al. 2025 ; Guo et al. 2025 ) . Uni-CoT further models macro- and micro-level CoT within a unified understanding-and-generation model, placing text, visual states, and generative actions in a shared model space ( Qin et al. 2025 ) . Existing visual CoT methods, however, often still reduce reflection to a longer prompt, a layout condition, or another round of whole-image generation. When the error is minor, such strategies discard visual content that is already correct; when the error is large, they may carry forward an incorrect layout from the current image and introduce new hallucinations during regeneration.
blocks.zh: 因此,将思维推理链扩展到图像生成是一个自然方向。 Visual CoT Difusion,ImageGen-CoT,以及阶梯式验证或加固方法都证明了中间推理对于图像生成的价值(Harvey and Wood 2023;Liao et al. 2025; 郭等 2025). Uni-CoT在统一的理解和生成模型内进一步建立宏和微观层次的CoT模型,将文本,视觉状态,基因动作置于共享模型空间中(秦等2025年). 然而,现有的视觉 CoT 方法往往仍然将反射减少为更长的即时,布局条件,或者另一轮全图像生成. 当错误轻微时,这种策略会丢弃已经正确的视觉内容;当错误很大时,它们可能会从当前图像中结转不正确的布局,并在再生过程中引入新的幻觉.

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows failure cases observed in our reproduction of prior work ( Qin et al. 2025 ) . In the top example, the prompt requires a dining table to the right of an oven, but the initial image places the oven too far to the right and couples it tightly to the scene depth. Image-conditioned repair reuses this layout and cannot accommodate the table farther to the right. In the bottom examples, the same image condition causes collateral errors: the model fails to turn coal into carbon ash, while a requested percussion instrument is fused with the pipa in the original image and loses its proper structure. These cases reveal two complementary risks—an incorrect image can become a negative visual anchor, and even a small edit can alter content outside its target—showing that repair granularity should depend on how much of the current image is worth preserving.
blocks.zh: 图1显示在复制先前的工作时观察到的失败案例(秦等人,2025年)。 在顶级例子中,提示需要一个烤箱右侧的餐桌,但最初的图像将烤箱放在右边太远的地方,而夫妇则紧紧地放在场景深度的地方. 以图像为条件的修复可以重用这种布局,无法容纳更靠近右侧的表格. 在底部的例子中,相同的图像条件会造成连带错误:模型未能将煤转化为碳灰,而请求的撞击仪器则与原始图像中的pipa结合,失去其适当的结构. 这些案例揭示了两种相辅相成的风险——不正确的图像可能成为负面的视觉主锚,即使是小的编辑也可以在目标之外改变内容——显示修复颗粒性应该取决于当前图像值得保存多少.

blocks.en: Figure 2 further shows how repeated whole-image regeneration can compound errors. In the top sequence, five correction rounds fail to remove the floating vase while repeatedly rewriting the initially clear sofa and background and accumulating grain noise. In the bottom sequence, the requested phone concept remains recognizable, but the hand and image texture progressively deform. Repair actions should therefore control their disruption scope explicitly: local repair can preserve valid regions and reduce newly introduced artifacts when only a limited area is wrong.
blocks.zh: 图2进一步显示了重复的全图像再生如何会复合错误. 在顶级序列中,5发校正弹未能移除浮瓶,同时反复重写最初清晰的沙发和背景,并积累谷物噪音. 在底层序列中,请求的电话概念仍然可以识别,但手和图像纹理逐渐变形. 因此,修理行动应明确控制其破坏范围:局部修理可以保留有效区域,并在只有有限区域错误时减少新引进的文物。

blocks.en: We propose MLIE-CoT, a new framework that converts visual reflection into a sequence of executable actions. It structures visual chain-of-thought as a test-time control process that observes the image, diagnoses errors, selects an action, and performs repair. Unlike textual CoT, the intermediate states of MLIE-CoT are actual images; unlike prompt rewriting alone, every step in MLIE-CoT is grounded in a concrete visual action. MLIE-CoT first uses L0 to accept satisfactory images; otherwise, it routes among L1 local/object-level repair, L2 image-conditioned whole-image editing, and L3 text-only regeneration. These four actions are ordered from least to most disruptive, allowing MLIE-CoT to discard the image condition only when the current image acts as a negative anchor. For limited local errors such as incorrect colors or counts, the framework preserves correct content whenever possible and repairs only the necessary regions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MLIE-CoT,这是一种将视觉反射转化为一系列可执行行动的新框架. 它将视觉思维链构建为一个测试时间控制过程,它观察图像,诊断错误,选择动作,并进行修复. 与文字CoT不同,MLIE-CoT的中间状态是实际的图像;与迅速重写单独不同,MLIE-CoT的每一个步骤都基于具体的视觉动作. MLIE-CoT首先使用L0来接受满意的图像;否则,它会在L1局部/对象级修复,L2图像有条件的全图像编辑,以及L3文本仅再生之间运行. 这四个动作被命令从最少到最破坏性,只当当前图像作为负锚时,MLIE-COT才能丢弃图像条件. 对于有限的局部错误,如不正确的颜色或计数,框架尽可能保留正确的内容,只修复必要的区域.

blocks.en: Allowing an MLLM to choose a repair strategy on its own provides no learned guidance, often requires expensive trial and error, and does not necessarily produce stable decisions. We therefore collect single-action repair results and use their measured action scores as supervision. At deployment time, the router input is limited to the current image, the target prompt, and a standardized fact-based diagnosis with a fixed structure. This learned level router changes the central decision in MLIE-CoT from prompt-based judgment to data-driven repair routing, while using action scores only for training supervision.
blocks.zh: 允许MLLM自行选择修补策略并不能提供学习到的指导,往往需要昂贵的试验和错误,也不一定产生稳定的决定. 因此,我们收集单行动修复结果,并使用其衡量的行动成绩作为监督。 在部署时,路由器输入仅限于当前图像,目标即时,以及具有固定结构的标准化基于事实的诊断. 这种学习的关卡路由器将MLIE-CoT中的中央决定从即时判断改为数据驱动的修复路由,同时只使用动作分数来进行训练监督.

blocks.en: We make three main contributions. First, we incorporate local repair into chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation, further unlocking the potential of intermediate images as reusable states. Second, we propose MLIE-CoT, which combines and routes among multi-level repair strategies. Its four fine-grained actions reduce new hallucinations introduced by untargeted prompt rewriting or whole-image regeneration. Third, we train and evaluate a repair-strategy router that learns the mapping from image states to repair granularity; experiments across multiple settings show that the router consistently improves image quality while providing better control over computational cost.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三个主要贡献。 首先,我们将局部修复纳入图像生成的思维链推理,进一步释放中间图像作为可重复使用状态的潜力. 第二,我们提出MLIE-CoT,它将多层次的维修战略结合起来和路线。 其四项精细的动作减少了非目标即时重写或全图像再生带来的新幻觉. 第三,我们训练和评价一个修补策略的路由器,从图像状态中学习映射来修复颗粒性;跨多个设置的实验显示,路由器不断提高图像质量,同时提供更好的计算成本控制.

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-image generation has progressed from adversarial and autoregressive architectures to diffusion models. AttnGAN uses word-level attention in multi-stage adversarial generation ( Xu et al. 2018 ) , while DALL-E autoregressively models a unified sequence of text and discrete image tokens ( Ramesh et al. 2021 ) . Imagen combines a large pretrained language encoder with cascaded diffusion ( Saharia et al. 2022 ) , and latent diffusion performs text-conditioned denoising in a compressed space, enabling efficient high-resolution systems such as Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al. 2022 ) . Together, these shifts improve text–image alignment, fidelity, and efficiency, making generation systems increasingly suitable as components of iterative pipelines rather than stand-alone samplers.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像生成从对抗式和自递式建筑发展到传播模型. AttnGAN在多阶段对抗生成中采用单词级别关注(徐等人,2018年),而DALL-E自旋模型则采用文本和离散图像符号的统一序列(Ramesh等人,2021年). Imagen将一个预先受过训练的大型语言编码器与级联扩散(Saharia等人,2022年)相结合,潜在扩散在压缩空间中进行文字条件化去诺,使稳定扩散(Rombach等人,2022年)等高效的高分辨率系统成为可能. 这些转变加在一起改善了文本-图像对齐、忠诚和效率,使生成系统越来越适合作为迭代管道的组成部分,而不是独立的采样器。

blocks.en: Conditioning interfaces have also expanded beyond one-shot generation from text and noise. ControlNet introduces spatial controls such as edges, depth, and pose, while InstructPix2Pix conditions editing on both an image and a natural-language instruction ( Zhang, Rao, and Agrawala 2023 ; Brooks, Holynski, and Efros 2023 ) . The task thus extends from describing a new image to continuing or modifying existing visual content. The source image supplies structure and semantics that need not be regenerated. More recent unified models directly support understanding, generation, and editing: BAGEL learns from mixed text, image, and video data and supports free-form editing ( Deng et al. 2025 ) , while FLUX.2 supports text-to-image, single-reference, and multi-reference editing ( Black Forest Labs 2025 ) . This shift turns generated images into reusable conditions, providing the model basis for MLIE-CoT’s full-image and local-crop repairs.
blocks.zh: 条件界面也从文字和噪音中扩展至一发生成. ControlNet引入了边缘,深度,姿势等空间控制,而InstructPix2Pix则同时以图像和自然语言指令为编辑条件(张,拉奥,阿格拉瓦拉2023;布鲁克斯,霍林斯基,和埃弗罗斯2023). 因此,任务从描述新图像到继续或修改现有视觉内容。 源图像提供不需要再生成的结构和语义. 更近代的统一模型直接支持理解,生成,和编辑:BAGEL从混合文本,图像,视频数据中学习,并支持自由格式编辑(Deng et al. 2025),而FLUX.2则支持文本对图像,单引用,和多参考编辑(Black Forest Labs 2025). 这一转变将生成的图像转化为可重复使用的条件,为MLIE-CoT的全图像和局部作物修复提供了模型基础.

blocks.en: The earlier PromptCoT uses an adapted textual chain of thought to combine prompt continuations and revisions, producing a text condition that better matches the generator’s preferred distribution before synthesis ( Yao et al. 2024 ) . ImageGen-CoT constructs reasoning chains for text-to-image in-context learning ( Liao et al. 2025 ) , while "Can We Generate Images with CoT?" studies stepwise verification, potential assessment, and reinforcement ( Guo et al. 2025 ) . Uni-CoT unifies macro- and micro-level CoT in an understanding-and-generation model ( Qin et al. 2025 ) . Although these methods show the value of reasoning, they largely express it through text, embeddings, rewards, or repeated generation. Repeated full-image generation can discard regions that already satisfy the prompt. MLIE-CoT instead treats generated images as visual states, preserving correct regions while assigning the current full image and local crops different roles in later reasoning.
blocks.zh: 早期的ExpressCoT使用一种经过调整的文字思维链,将即时续作和修改结合起来,产生一个文本条件,在合成之前更好地匹配生成器的首选分布(姚等人,2024年). 图像 Gen-CoT为文本对图像的内涵学习构建推理链(廖等2025年),同时"我们能用COT生成图像吗?"研究一步步验证,潜在评估,加固(郭等2025年). Uni-CoT在理解和生成模型中统一宏观和微观水平的CoT(秦等2025年). 虽然这些方法显示了推理的价值,但是它们基本上通过文字,嵌入,奖励,或者重复代代来表达. 重复的全图像生成可以丢弃已经满足快感的区域. 相反,MLIE-CoT将生成的图像视为可视状态,保留正确的区域,同时在以后的推理中将当前完整的图像和当地作物分配到不同的角色.

blocks.en:
Complex generation can be broken down across semantic levels or spatial scales. Cascaded diffusion conditions later stages on low-resolution outputs to add detail ( Ho et al. 2022 ) , while Visual Chain-of-Thought Diffusion Models generate pixels through an intermediate semantic CLIP embedding ( Harvey and Wood 2023 ) . These methods establish intermediate visual states as useful generation conditions. ElasticDiffusion separates global signals for structural consistency from local patch signals for low-level detail ( Haji-Ali, Balakrishnan, and
Ordonez 2024 ) . Similarly, the Describe Anything Model combines global context with a high-resolution focus region for region-level understanding ( Lian et al. 2025 ) . The full image provides composition and surrounding context, while crops retain detail that resizing can hide. This pairing is especially useful when an error is limited to one region but its correction must remain consistent with the scene. MLIE-CoT applies this global–local combination to post-generation repair: the current image preserves layout and correct content, while crops focus editing on incorrect regions. Rather than following a fixed coarse-to-fine process, it routes among local repair, whole-image editing, and text-only regeneration according to error scope.
blocks.zh:
复杂的生成可以在语义层面或空间尺度上分解. 低分辨率输出的后期出现散射条件,以添加细节(Ho等人,2022年),而视觉链式散射模型通过中间语义CLIP嵌入(Harvey and Wood 2023年)生成像素. 这些方法将中间视觉状态确立为有用的生成条件. 弹性分散式将结构一致性的全球信号与局部补丁信号区分开来,用于低级细节(Haji-Ali,Balakrishnan,以及
Ordonez 2024 (英语). 同样, " 描述一切 " 模式将全球背景与高分辨率重点区域结合起来,供区域一级理解(Lian等人,2025年)。 完整的图像提供了成分和周围环境,而农作物保留了可以隐藏的再大小的细节. 当一个错误局限于一个区域时,这种配对特别有用,但其纠正必须与现场保持一致。 MLIE-CoT将这种全球-局部组合应用于生成后修复:当前图像保留了布局和正确的内容,而作物则将编辑的重点放在不正确的区域上. 它不是遵循固定的粗对细流程,而是按照错误范围,在局部修复、整幅图像编辑和仅重现文本之间传递。

blocks.en: Earlier local editing methods relied on explicit regions or layers. With a user-provided mask, Blended Diffusion combines local generation with a noised original during reverse diffusion to preserve unmasked content ( Avrahami, Lischinski, and Fried 2022 ) ; Text2LIVE instead places a generated RGBA editing layer onto the image ( Bar-Tal et al. 2022 ) . LLM-grounded Diffusion generates foreground objects separately, extracts their masks, and combines their latent features on a global canvas ( Lian et al. 2024 ) . Self-correcting LLM-controlled Diffusion Models automate this process: a detector and an LLM compare current and target layouts, translate differences into object-level operations, and use segmentation and diffusion to repair blending errors ( Wu et al. 2024 ) . ZONE also finds an instructed region, extracts a local layer, and puts it back with edge smoothing ( Li et al. 2024 ) . These methods close the loop from detection to correction, but still rely on fixed local operations. MLIE-CoT also decides whether an observed failure is best handled locally or requires a broader repair. These approaches show that restricting edits to incorrect regions helps preserve correct content, motivating MLIE-CoT’s local repair level.
blocks.zh: 早期的本地编辑方法依赖于明确的区域或层次. 使用用户提供的面具,Blended Difusion在反向扩散时结合了本地生成和点名的原创,以保存未涂抹的内容(Avrahami,Lischinski,和Fried 2022) ;Text2LIVE转而将生成的RGBA编辑层放置在图像上(Bar-Tal等人,2022年). LLM基底的扩散分别生成前景物体,提取它们的面具,并结合它们在全球画布上的潜在特征(Lian等人,2024年). 自修正 LLM 控制 扩散模型使这一过程自动化:一个探测器和一个LLM比较电流和目标布局,将差异转化为对象级操作,并使用分割和传播来修复混合错误(Wu等人,2024年). ZONE还发现了一个指示区域,提取出一个局部层,并放回边缘平滑(Li等人,2024年). 这些方法关闭了从检测到校正的循环,但仍然依赖于固定的局部操作. MLIE-CoT也决定所观察到的故障是最好在当地处理还是需要更广泛的修复. 这些方法表明,将编辑限制在不正确的区域有助于保存正确的内容,激励MIE-CoT的本地修复水平。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Overview of the MLIE-CoT framework. The analyzer identifies mismatches between the prompt and current image. A frozen multimodal reasoning backbone feeds its representation to a trainable three-way prediction head, which selects L1 local editing with cropped regions, L2 whole-image editing conditioned on the current image, or L3 regeneration by the prompt refiner and generator. The critic examines the new image: a pass returns the final image and terminates, whereas a failure sends the result back for another diagnosis and repair round.

blocks.en: Hierarchical Repair and Repair Acceptance

blocks.en: Different errors require changes at different scopes. Local issues involving color, attributes, or a small number of objects generally favor targeted repair. Background, spatial-relation, and layout errors call for whole-image editing. When the main concept, multi-object composition, or overall arrangement is incorrect, the current image itself may repeatedly mislead the editor, making text-only regeneration more appropriate. Because no single repair path is best in all cases, MLIE-CoT defines three repair levels with increasingly broad scopes. These levels describe how much of the current image is preserved rather than the difficulty of the error, allowing the router to adjust intervention strength while reusing the same diagnostic representation as the visual state evolves. Table 1 summarizes their intended use, and Figure 3 presents typical examples.

blocks.en: We construct 1K prompts and sample each repair level five times, yielding a routing-training dataset of 14.8K images. We freeze Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team 2026 ) and train only the two-layer routing head with the composite objective in Eq. ( 9 ). blocks.en: Experimental Setup and Configuration
blocks.zh: 实验设置和配置

blocks.en: We mainly evaluate the improvements of MLIE-CoT in text-to-image semantic alignment and reasoning-intensive generation using GenEval ( Ghosh, Hajishirzi, and Schmidt 2023 ) and WISE ( Niu et al. 2025 ) . GenEval contains 553 object-centered prompts covering single objects, two objects, counting, colors, spatial positions, and color-attribute binding. Its official evaluator uses object detection and instance segmentation to determine whether all constraints are satisfied together, and Overall is the average of the six category accuracies. WISE contains 1,000 prompts covering cultural knowledge, time, space, biology, physics, and chemistry. Unlike compositional prompts that directly name the target, WISE often specifies it indirectly through knowledge clues, space-time relations, or scientific conditions, testing whether a model can first recover the hidden knowledge and then correctly show the inferred conclusion in the image.
blocks.zh: 我们主要利用GenEval(Ghosh、Hajishirzi和Smidt 2023)和WISE(Niu 等人,2025年)来评价MLIE-CoT在文本到图像语义对齐和推理密集型生成方面的改进。 GenEval包含553个以对象为中心的提示,涵盖单个对象,两个对象,计数,颜色,空间位置,以及色彩属性绑定. 其官方评价人员使用物体检测和实例分割来确定所有约束是否共同满足,总体来说是六个类的平均值. WISE包含1000个提示,涵盖文化知识,时间,空间,生物学,物理学和化学. 与直接给目标命名的成份提示不同,WISE经常通过知识线索,时空关系,或科学条件间接指定它,测试一个模型是否能够首先恢复隐藏的知识,然后在图像中正确显示推断的结论.

blocks.en: Independent Gains and the Added Benefit of Combining the Three Repair Actions
blocks.zh: 独立收益和合并三个修复行动的附加收益

blocks.en: To test whether combining multiple repair strategies is necessary, we compare against fixed repair policies. The generation backbone is FLUX.2-dev, and the vision-language backbone shared by the analyzer and router is a frozen Qwen3.5-9B. All four policies reuse exactly the same set of 553 initial images at a resolution of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 on a per-sample basis rather than resampling them independently; differences in the table therefore arise only from the subsequent repair policy. L1-to-L3-only denotes a setting in which the model iteratively refines images with a predefined repair strategy. Self-route denotes a model-driven inference routing strategy that dynamically selects the repair process based on the coarse-grained image repair taxonomy introduced in Table 1.
blocks.zh: 为了检验结合多种维修策略是否必要,我们比较了固定的维修政策. 生成主干是FLUX.2-dev,分析器和路由器共用的视觉语言主干是冷冻的Quen3.5-9B. 所有四种政策在每例1024×1024 1024\times 1024的分辨率下重新使用完全相同的553套初步图像,而不是独立复制;因此,表中的差异只产生于后续的修复政策. L1–to–L3–仅表示模型以预定义的修复策略迭代精炼图像的设置. 自序表示一种模型驱动的推论路由策略,根据表1中引入的粗重图像修复分类法,动态选择修复过程.

blocks.en: With the same initial images strictly shared across policies, Table 4 shows that all three fixed actions improve the results but suit different scopes: L1 preserves content while making local corrections, L2 coordinates global attributes and layout, and L3 resets samples that cannot be repaired reliably. Router further raises accuracy to 88%. Its advantage therefore comes from deciding how much information from the current image to preserve according to error severity; this error heterogeneity is the fundamental reason multi-level routing outperforms fixed repair.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,由于政策之间严格共享相同的初始图像,所有三个固定动作都改进了结果,但适合不同的范围:L1在进行局部校正的同时保留内容,L2协调全球属性和布局,以及L3重置样本无法可靠修复. 路由器进一步将精度提高到88%. 因此它的优点在于决定从当前图像中获取多少信息,以根据错误的严重程度保存;这种错误的异质性是多层次的路由性超过固定修复的根本原因.

blocks.en: Effect and Complexity Analysis of the Number of Chain-of-Thought Steps
blocks.zh: 思考步骤数量的影响和复杂性分析

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought methods typically use additional reasoning and incur extra computation in exchange for better generation quality, and the length of chain effect the cost most. We design an ablation experiment on Chain-of-Thought Steps. We use generation count to represent the added cost as analysis and routing are negligible relative to generation, while wall-clock time is hardware- and implementation-dependent. Figure 5 shows that larger step budgets generally improve or maintain performance, but the gains have a clear ceiling. Increasing the repair budget gives difficult samples more opportunities to correct remaining errors, but it does not guarantee that performance will continue to rise as more steps are used. The resulting benefit depends jointly on the reasoning demands of the task and the correctable error space left by the base model. The main value of a larger step budget is therefore not unlimited score gains, but broader coverage of difficult samples that may require additional repair attempts.
blocks.zh: 思维链方法通常使用附加推理,并进行额外计算,以换取更好的生成质量,而且链长影响成本最大。 我们设计了脑链步骤的消毒实验 我们使用生成计数来表示增加的费用,因为与生成相比,分析和路由可忽略不计,而墙钟时间则取决于硬件和执行。 图5显示,较大的分级预算一般能改善或维持业绩,但收益有明确的上限。 增加修补预算使困难的样本有更多的机会纠正剩余的错误,但这并不能保证随着更多步骤的使用,性能将继续上升. 由此带来的惠益共同取决于任务的推理要求和基础模型留下的可纠正错误空间. 因此,一个较大的步骤预算的主要价值不是无限的得分收益,而是扩大可能需要更多修理的艰难样品的覆盖面。

blocks.en: Quality and cost therefore do not scale linearly with the number of repair steps. A small number of steps provides a cost-effective default, whereas raising the upper limit allows the system to attempt harder tasks at the price of additional computation. Because the review-and-accept mechanism preserves an improved result and rejects unsuccessful revisions, we do not observe obvious noise accumulation or image-quality degradation over multiple repair steps. Nevertheless, inherent model noise and capacity limits mean that additional steps do not necessarily yield higher quality and may merely add cost. Our results therefore suggest that one to three repair steps offer the most efficient operating range.
blocks.zh: 因此,质量和成本没有随修理步骤的数目而线性地扩大。 少量步骤提供了成本效益高的默认,而提高上限则允许系统以额外计算的价格尝试更困难的任务. 由于审查与接受机制保持了更好的结果,并拒绝不成功的修改,我们没有看到在多个修复步骤上明显的噪音积累或图像质量退化。 然而,固有的模型噪音和容量限制意味着额外的步骤不一定产生更高的质量,可能只是增加成本。 因此,我们的结果表明,一至三个修理步骤提供了最有效的操作范围。

blocks.en: For context, we also compare the cost with that of other methods for optimizing image generation. In our reproduction using the default settings, Uni-CoT generates an average of 1.107 images per prompt on GenEval and 1.449 images per prompt on WISE. These results indicate that the additional generation cost introduced by our method remains broadly comparable to that of existing chain-of-thought methods, rather than requiring a substantially larger number of image-generation calls.
blocks.zh: 就背景而言,我们还比较了优化图像生成的其他方法的成本。 在我们使用默认设置进行复制时,Uni-CoT在GenEval上生成平均每秒1.107的图像,在WISE上生成平均每秒1.449的图像. 这些结果表明,我们采用的方法带来的额外生成成本与现有的思维链方法大致相当,而不是需要大量图像生成呼叫。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: MLIE-CoT combines local repair, whole-image editing, and text-only regeneration to reduce hallucination accumulation and local-detail errors. A strict same-initial-image GenEval ablation shows that router outperforms any fixed action and self-route. The framework is model-agnostic: native multimodal models can serve directly as action tools, while models that support reference-image inputs can serve as image-generation backbones. In the future, targeted optimization of repair prompts is a promising direction. Current models also generate at fixed, limited resolutions. Image-generation CoT may help extend them to larger images, particularly for complex tasks that cannot be completed reliably in a single generation.
blocks.zh: MLIE-CoT结合了局部修复,全图像编辑,以及仅文本的再生,以减少幻觉积累和局部细节错误. 严格的同源图像 GenEval 放大显示,路由器比任何固定的动作和自我路线都要好. 框架是模型-不可知的:本土多式联运模型可以直接作为行动工具,而支持参考图像输入的模型可以作为图像生成的骨干. 今后,有针对性地优化修复提示是一个有希望的方向. 目前的模型也在固定的有限分辨率下产生. 图像生成CoT可能有助于将其扩展至更大的图像,特别是对于在一代人中无法可靠完成的复杂任务.

blocks.en: Implementation and Optimization
blocks.zh: 执行和优化

blocks.en:
The 1K prompts, five samples per level, and three levels yield 15K images.
Qwen3.5-9B is frozen and loaded in 8-bit precision; its final non-padding
token provides a 4,096-dimensional feature. We train the two-layer head with
AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter 2019 ) : learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , batch size 256 256 , at most 300 300 epochs, early-stopping patience 40 40 , minimum improvement 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and gradient-norm cap 5.0 5.0 . The
training seed is 20260719; it initializes Python, PyTorch, and all CUDA
generators, while epoch e e uses seed 20260719 + e 20260719+e for the training
permutation. Checkpoint selection minimizes validation quality regret, then
measured action cost, then validation loss; the selected checkpoint is from
epoch 110. The test split is not used for checkpoint selection.

blocks.en:
The analyzer and router use Qwen3.5-9B as their backbone. The model offers
strong multimodal understanding and has a parameter count comparable to
those of FLUX.2-dev and BAGEL, which helps avoid scaling-law confounds when
it is used as a component of the reasoning chain. We use immutable revision c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a , loaded in BF16 with
8-bit weights and no CPU offload. Analyzer inputs have maximum long side
1,536 and maximum 1,536 new tokens; review and comparison images have maximum
long side 1,024. Normal decoding uses do_sample=false ; the
deterministic malformed-output retry additionally uses repetition penalty
1.05 and no-repeat n-gram size 8.

four evaluator seeds (20260725–20260728) on identical frozen images; these
are evaluator repetitions and are not additional generation trajectories.

blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en:
GenEval reports the official mean for each of its six task categories and
defines Overall as the unweighted mean of those six category means. WISE
uses one valid binary decision for each unique prompt ID 1–1000; Overall is
the mean of those 1,000 decisions, and category scores are means over the
corresponding official ID subsets. We do not label an incomplete or
duplicate-ID WISE evaluation as an official Overall score. These benchmarks
were selected because GenEval measures explicit compositional constraints,
whereas WISE measures whether implicit cultural, spatiotemporal, and
scientific knowledge is correctly recovered and depicted.
